convert_hf_dataset_to_binary_file: convert a huggingface dataset from disk into a binary file with separator-delimited text entries
sample_dataset_with_rate: sample a huggingface dataset at a configurable rate and write filtered entries to a binary file
tokenize_dataset_with_gpt2_or_t5: tokenize dataset text entries using gpt2 or t5 tokenizer and serialize to binary format
generate_position_index_for_dataset: generate a position-to-id mapping pickle file and cumulative size array for random access into the binary dataset file
filter_long_texts_from_dataset: filter out dataset entries exceeding a text length threshold while writing remaining entries to a binary file
